title: Health in depth
goal: Describe symptoms precisely and say how long you have had them, mention allergies and conditions, follow a doctor’s or pharmacist’s instructions and book tests.
intro:
Unit 9 got you to the doctor. This unit lets you have the whole conversation: what exactly hurts and how (**ଜଳୁଛି** 'burning', **କୁଣ୍ଡାଉଛି** 'itching', **ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଲାଉଛି** 'I'm dizzy'), **since when** and **for how long**, what you are allergic to, and what the doctor tells you to do: **ଦିନକୁ ଦୁଇ ଥର ଖାଇବା ପରେ** 'twice a day after food'.

The big grammar point is a difference from English: Odia says 'I *am having* a fever for three days' — **ତିନି ଦିନ ହେଲା ଜ୍ୱର ହେଉଛି** — with the present tense, because the fever is still going on.

vocab.en: to feel dizzy (lit. the head spins)
vocab.note: Always with ମୁଣ୍ଡ as subject: ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଲାଉଛି 'I feel dizzy'.
ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେବା 'to breathe'. In speech also ନିଶ୍ୱାସ.
-ବାରେ କଷ୍ଟ ହେବା 'to have trouble …ing': ଚାଲିବାରେ କଷ୍ଟ ହେଉଛି.
Usually as ଫୁଲିଯିବା: ଗୋଡ଼ ଫୁଲିଯାଇଛି 'my leg has swollen'.
The body part is the subject: ହାତ କୁଣ୍ଡାଉଛି 'my hand itches'.

vocab.en: to burn (also of a burning sensation)
vocab.note: ଆଖି ଜଳୁଛି 'my eyes are burning'; ପେଟ ଜଳୁଛି 'heartburn'.
ଦେହ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଲାଗୁଛି 'I feel weak'.
Lit. 'holding': ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତାହ ଧରି 'for two weeks'.
Colloquially କେବେଠୁ.
ମୋର … ଆଲର୍ଜି ଅଛି 'I have an allergy'; … ଖାଇଲେ ଆଲର୍ଜି ହୁଏ 'I get an allergy if I eat …'.
Everyday word: ମୋର ସୁଗାର୍ ଅଛି 'I'm diabetic'. Medical: ମଧୁମେହ.
ବିପି ବେଶି / କମ 'high / low BP'. Formal: ରକ୍ତଚାପ.
Formal: ବଟିକା. You "eat" tablets: ଟାବଲେଟ୍ ଖାଇବା.
You "drink" syrup: ସିରପ୍ ପିଇବା.
ଦୁଇ ଥର 'twice', ତିନି ଥର 'three times'; ଥରେ 'once' (unit 16).
Also ପର୍ଚି 'chit'.
Very common complaint: ଗ୍ୟାସ୍ ହୋଇଛି 'I've got acidity'.
ରକ୍ତ ଟେଷ୍ଟ 'blood test'; ଟେଷ୍ଟ କରିବା / କରାଇବା 'to do / get a test done'. Formal: ପରୀକ୍ଷା.
ଇଞ୍ଜେକସନ୍ ଦେବା (doctor) / ନେବା (patient).
ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନାରେ ଭର୍ତ୍ତି ହେବା 'to be admitted'. Also used for admission to a school or college.

vocab.en: oily, spicy food (lit. oil and spices)
vocab.note: The doctor's favourite ban: ତେଲ ମସଲା ବନ୍ଦ!
ହାଲୁକା ଖାଦ୍ୟ 'light food'; ବାହାର ଖାଦ୍ୟ 'eating out, outside food'.
Opposite of ଅସୁସ୍ଥ (unit 9). ସୁସ୍ଥ ହେବା 'to get well'.

grammar.title: 'I've had it for three days': present tense + ହେଲା, ଧରି, -ଠାରୁ
grammar.body:
English says 'I **have had** a fever for three days'. Odia looks at it differently: the fever is **still going on**, so it uses the **present** — continuous **-ଉଛି** for something happening (ଜ୍ୱର ହେଉଛି, ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବିନ୍ଧୁଛି, ବାନ୍ତି ହେଉଛି) or **ଅଛି** for a state (କାଶ ଅଛି, ସୁଗାର୍ ଅଛି) — and adds a time phrase.

**Three ways to give the time:**
**X ହେଲା** 'it's been X' — the most colloquial; ହେଲା never changes: ତିନି ଦିନ **ହେଲା** ଜ୍ୱର ହେଉଛି.
**X ଧରି** 'for X' (lit. holding X): ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତାହ **ଧରି** କାଶ ଅଛି.
**-ଠାରୁ / -ରୁ** 'since': କାଲି**ଠାରୁ**, ସୋମବାର**ଠାରୁ**, ସକାଳ**ୁ** 'since the morning', ପିଲାଦିନ**ରୁ** 'since childhood'. In speech -ଠାରୁ shrinks to **-ଠୁ**: କାଲିଠୁ.

**Asking:** **କେବେଠାରୁ?** 'since when?' · **କେତେ ଦିନ ହେଲା?** 'how long has it been?'

**When it started:** use the past with **ତଳେ** 'ago': ତିନି ଦିନ **ତଳେ** ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେଲା 'it started three days ago'.

**Something that keeps happening:** use the simple present: ରାତିରେ କାଶ **ହୁଏ** 'I cough at night', ଚାଲିଲେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେବାରେ କଷ୍ଟ **ହୁଏ** 'I get breathless when I walk'.

**Not yet / haven't since:** the negative perfect, usually in its short form: ସକାଳୁ କିଛି **ଖାଇନି** 'I haven't eaten anything since morning' (careful: ଖାଇ ନାହିଁ).

**The trap:** the simple **past** means it's over: ତିନି ଦିନ ଜ୍ୱର **ହେଲା** 'I had a fever for three days (and now it's gone)'. If you still have it, say ତିନି ଦିନ ହେଲା ଜ୍ୱର **ହେଉଛି**. (The perfect ଜ୍ୱର **ହୋଇଛି** 'I've got a fever' is fine — it describes the state you are in now.)

grammar.title: Instructions: how much, how often, before or after food
grammar.body:
Doctors and pharmacists give instructions with the **future** — polite **ଖାଇବେ, ପିଇବେ, ନେବେ** (or familiar **ଖାଇବ** to a young patient) — or the polite command **ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ, ପିଅନ୍ତୁ**. The negative adds ନାହିଁ: ଖାଇବେ ନାହିଁ, ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ. Note that in Odia you **eat** tablets (ଟାବଲେଟ୍ ଖାଇବା), **drink** syrup (ସିରପ୍ ପିଇବା) and **take/give** injections (ଇଞ୍ଜେକସନ୍ ନେବା / ଦେବା).

**How often — the -କୁ 'per' ending:** ଦିନ**କୁ** ଦୁଇ ଥର 'twice a day', ସପ୍ତାହ**କୁ** ଥରେ 'once a week'. Or name the times: ସକାଳେ ଗୋଟିଏ, ରାତିରେ ଗୋଟିଏ 'one in the morning, one at night'; ଛଅ ଘଣ୍ଟାରେ ଥରେ 'once every six hours'.

**When — -ବା + ପରେ / ଆଗରୁ** (the same -ବା pattern as ବେଳେ and ମାତ୍ରେ in unit 30): ଖାଇବା **ପରେ** 'after food', ଖାଇବା **ଆଗରୁ** 'before food', ଶୋଇବା **ଆଗରୁ** 'at bedtime', ଖାଲି ପେଟରେ 'on an empty stomach'.

**How much:** ଗୋଟିଏ ଟାବଲେଟ୍, ଅଧା ଟାବଲେଟ୍, ଦୁଇ ଚାମଚ ସିରପ୍.

**How long:** X **ଯାଏ / ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ**: ପାଞ୍ଚ ଦିନ ଯାଏ ଖାଇବେ 'take it for five days'. 'Don't stop halfway' is ମଝିରେ ଛାଡ଼ିବେ ନାହିଁ.

**Must / should** (units 9 and 15): -ବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ 'you'll have to', -ବା ଉଚିତ 'you should', and the doctor's favourite **-ବା ଦରକାର**: ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନେବା ଦରକାର 'you need rest'.

**Word order:** thing → how often → when → verb at the end: ଏହି ଟାବଲେଟ୍ | ଦିନକୁ ଦୁଇ ଥର | ଖାଇବା ପରେ | ଖାଇବେ.

**The trap:** 'per day' needs **-କୁ**: ~~ଦିନ ଦୁଇ ଥର~~ → ଦିନ**କୁ** ଦୁଇ ଥର. And ପରେ / ଆଗରୁ follow the **-ବା** form, not a tense: ~~ଖାଇଲି ପରେ~~ → ଖାଇବା ପରେ.

dialogue.title: At the doctor’s chamber in Cuttack
dialogue.setting: Evening at Dr Patnaik's private clinic near Buxi Bazaar, Cuttack, in the rainy season. The doctor is older and uses ତୁମେ with Ananya, a young patient; she answers with ଆପଣ.

lines.speaker: Dr Patnaik
lines.en: Have a seat. Tell me what's wrong.

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ଡାକ୍ତରବାବୁ, ତିନି ଦିନ ହେଲା ମୋର ଜ୍ୱର ହେଉଛି, ଆଉ ଦେହ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଲାଗୁଛି।
lines.roman: ḍaktôrôbabu, tini dinô hela morô jwôrô heuchhi, au dehô durbôḷô laguchhi.
lines.en: Doctor, I've had a fever for three days, and I feel weak.

lines.speaker: Dr Patnaik
lines.en: How high was it? Did you measure it?

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ହଁ, କାଲି ରାତିରେ ଏକଶହ ଦୁଇ ଥିଲା। ସକାଳୁ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବି ବିନ୍ଧୁଛି।
lines.roman: hôṃ, kali ratire ekôsôhô dui thila. sôkaḷu muṇḍô bi bindhuchhi.
lines.en: Yes, it was 102 last night. And I've had a headache since this morning.

lines.speaker: Dr Patnaik
lines.en: Any vomiting? Are your joints aching?

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ବାନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଗଣ୍ଠି ବହୁତ ବିନ୍ଧୁଛି। ଡେଙ୍ଗୁ ନୁହେଁ ତ?
lines.roman: banti nahiṃ, kintu gôṇṭhi bôhutô bindhuchhi. ḍeṅgu nuheṃ tô?
lines.en: No vomiting, but my joints really hurt. It's not dengue, is it?

lines.speaker: Dr Patnaik
lines.native: ଏବେ କହି ହେବ ନାହିଁ। ରକ୍ତ ଟେଷ୍ଟ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ। କୌଣସି ଔଷଧରେ ଆଲର୍ଜି ଅଛି?
lines.roman: ebe kôhi hebô nahiṃ. rôktô ṭesṭ kôribaku pôṛibô. kôuṇôsi ôusôdhôre alôrji ôchhi?
lines.en: Can't say yet. We'll need a blood test. Are you allergic to any medicine?

lines.speaker: Dr Patnaik
lines.native: ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି। ଏ ପାରାସିଟାମଲ୍ ଦିନକୁ ତିନି ଥର ଖାଇବା ପରେ ଖାଇବ। ପ୍ରଚୁର ପାଣି ପିଇବ, ଆଉ ତେଲ ମସଲା ବନ୍ଦ।
lines.roman: ṭhik ôchhi. e parasiṭamôl dinôku tini thôrô khaiba pôre khaibô. prôchurô paṇi piibô, au telô môsôla bôndô.
lines.en: All right. Take this paracetamol three times a day after food. Drink lots of water, and no oily or spicy food.

lines.speaker: Ananya
lines.native: ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଣା ପାଇଁ ଅନ୍ୟ କୌଣସି ଟାବଲେଟ୍ ଖାଇପାରିବି କି?
lines.roman: jôntrôṇa paiṃ ônnyô kôuṇôsi ṭableṭ khaiparibi ki?
lines.en: Can I take any other tablet for the pain?

lines.speaker: Dr Patnaik
lines.native: ନା, ନିଜେ ନିଜେ କିଛି ଖାଇବ ନାହିଁ। ଟେଷ୍ଟ ରିପୋର୍ଟ ଆସିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ମୋତେ ଦେଖାଇବ।
lines.roman: na, nije nije kichhi khaibô nahiṃ. ṭesṭ riporṭ asiba matre mote dekhaibô.
lines.en: No — don't take anything on your own. Show me the test report as soon as it comes.

lines.speaker: Dr Patnaik
lines.native: ବାହାରେ କାଉଣ୍ଟରରେ ଦେଇଦିଅ। ଶୀଘ୍ର ସୁସ୍ଥ ହୁଅ!
lines.roman: bahare kauṇṭôrôre deidiô. sighrô susthô huô!
lines.en: Pay at the counter outside. Get well soon!

culture:
Doctors in Odisha are addressed as **ଡାକ୍ତରବାବୁ** (or **ଡାକ୍ତର ମ୍ୟାଡାମ୍**), and many government doctors also see patients in the evening at a private **chamber** — people say the doctor **ବସନ୍ତି** 'sits' there from six to nine. The big public hospitals everyone names are **SCB Medical College** in Cuttack, **AIIMS** and **Capital Hospital** in Bhubaneswar; many families use the state health card (BSKY) at these and at listed private hospitals.

The neighbourhood **ମେଡିକାଲ** (pharmacy) is often the first stop: pharmacists give advice and sell many medicines over the counter, but antibiotics and strong painkillers should come with a prescription. In the monsoon, fever plus joint pain makes everyone think of **dengue** (and malaria in some districts), so doctors ask for a blood test early and warn against taking painkillers other than paracetamol on your own. In summer, especially in western Odisha, heatstroke (**ଲୁ**) is serious: people drink **ପଖାଳ**, lemon water and ORS.

Health is a normal topic of conversation: expect **ଦେହ ଭଲ ତ?** from neighbours and plenty of home advice — don't drink cold water, eat light food, have turmeric milk. Visitors to a patient bring fruit (apples, oranges, bananas) or Horlicks, and often stay for a long chat; in hospitals a relative usually stays with the patient day and night.

tip.title: Saying what hurts and how
tip.body:
- Body part + verb: ମୁଣ୍ଡ **ବିନ୍ଧୁଛି** (aches), ଆଖି **ଜଳୁଛି** (burns), ହାତ **କୁଣ୍ଡାଉଛି** (itches), ଗୋଡ଼ **ଫୁଲିଯାଇଛି** (has swollen).
- 'Trouble …ing': -ବାରେ **କଷ୍ଟ** ହେଉଛି: ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେବାରେ କଷ୍ଟ.
- ଦେହ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଲାଗୁଛି 'I feel weak'; ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଲାଉଛି 'I'm dizzy'.
tip.pattern: body part + ବିନ୍ଧୁଛି / ଜଳୁଛି / କୁଣ୍ଡାଉଛି  ·  verb-ବାରେ + କଷ୍ଟ ହେଉଛି

sentences.native: ଖରାରେ ମୋ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଲାଉଛି, ଟିକେ ବସିବି।

sentences.en: I feel dizzy in this heat — I'll sit down for a bit.
My leg has swollen up.
My hand is really itchy.
My eyes are burning and watering.
I feel weak after the fever.

Any other symptoms?

lessons.title: Since when? For how long?

tip.title: Still going on → present tense
tip.body:
- **X ହେଲା** + present: ତିନି ଦିନ **ହେଲା** ଜ୍ୱର ହେଉଛି 'for three days'.
- **X ଧରି** 'for X'; **-ଠାରୁ / -ରୁ** 'since': କାଲିଠାରୁ, ସକାଳୁ.
- Ask **କେବେଠାରୁ?** 'since when?'
- Past ଜ୍ୱର **ହେଲା** = it's over.
tip.pattern: X ହେଲା / X ଧରି / X-ଠାରୁ + present (-ଉଛି / ଅଛି)

new: ମୋର ତିନି ଦିନ ହେଲା ଜ୍ୱର ହେଉଛି।

sentences.en: Since when have you had the cough?

sentences.native: ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତାହ ଧରି ମୋର କାଶ ଅଛି।
sentences.roman: dui sôptahô dhôri morô kasô ôchhi.
sentences.en: I've had a cough for two weeks.

sentences.native: ମୋର ପାଞ୍ଚ ଦିନ ହେଲା ପେଟ ଖରାପ ଅଛି।
sentences.roman: morô pañchô dinô hela peṭô khôrapô ôchhi.
sentences.en: I've had an upset stomach for five days.
I haven't been to the office since Monday.

sentences.native: ବାପାଙ୍କର ଦଶ ବର୍ଷ ହେଲା ସୁଗାର୍ ଅଛି।
sentences.roman: bapaṅkôrô dôsô bôrsô hela sugar ôchhi.
sentences.en: Dad has been diabetic for ten years.

sentences.native: ମୋ ମାଙ୍କ ବିପି ବେଶି, ସେ ସବୁଦିନ ଔଷଧ ଖାଆନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: mo maṅkô bipi besi, se sôbudinô ôusôdhô khaanti.
sentences.en: My mum has high blood pressure; she takes medicine every day.
Do you have any allergies?
I've had this allergy since I was a child.

sentences.native: ତିନି ଦିନ ଜ୍ୱର ହେଲା, ଏବେ ଭଲ ଅଛି।
sentences.roman: tini dinô jwôrô hela, ebe bhôlô ôchhi.
sentences.en: I had a fever for three days; I’m fine now.
I've had a headache since this morning.

lessons.title: At the pharmacy

tip.title: Instructions: per day, before/after food
tip.body:
- 'Per': **-କୁ** — ଦିନ**କୁ** ଦୁଇ ଥର.
- When: **-ବା ପରେ / -ବା ଆଗରୁ** — ଖାଇବା ପରେ, ଶୋଇବା ଆଗରୁ; ଖାଲି ପେଟରେ.
- The verb: polite future **ଖାଇବେ / ପିଇବେ**, or **ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ**; negative + ନାହିଁ.
- Tablets are 'eaten', syrup is 'drunk'.
tip.pattern: thing + ଦିନକୁ X ଥର + ଖାଇବା ପରେ + ଖାଇବେ

new: ଏହି ଟାବଲେଟ୍ ଦିନକୁ ଦୁଇ ଥର ଖାଇବା ପରେ ଖାଇବେ।

sentences.native: ସକାଳେ ଗୋଟିଏ, ରାତିରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଟାବଲେଟ୍ ଖାଇବେ।
sentences.roman: sôkaḷe goṭie, ratire goṭie ṭableṭ khaibe.
sentences.en: One tablet in the morning and one at night.
How many times a day should I take it?
Give the child half a spoonful of syrup.

sentences.native: ଏହା ଖାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ନା ଖାଇବା ପରେ?
sentences.roman: eha khaiba agôru na khaiba pôre?
sentences.en: Before food or after food?
Could you give me something for acidity?

sentences.native: ଏ ଟାବଲେଟ୍ ସକାଳେ ଖାଲି ପେଟରେ ଖାଇବେ।
sentences.roman: e ṭableṭ sôkaḷe khali peṭôre khaibe.
sentences.en: Take this tablet in the morning on an empty stomach.

sentences.native: ଏ ଔଷଧ ପ୍ରେସକ୍ରିପସନ୍ ବିନା ଦିଆଯିବ ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: e ôusôdhô preskripsôn bina diajibô nahiṃ.
sentences.en: This medicine can't be sold without a prescription.

sentences.native: ସିରପ୍ ପିଇବା ପରେ ଅଧ ଘଣ୍ଟା ପାଣି ପିଇବେ ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: sirôp piiba pôre ôdhô ghôṇṭa paṇi piibe nahiṃ.
sentences.en: Don't drink water for half an hour after the syrup.
Just once at bedtime, that’s all. (familiar)
Could I see the prescription, please?
The doctor's appointment is tomorrow at five in the evening.

sentences.native: ରକ୍ତ ଟେଷ୍ଟ ପାଇଁ ଖାଲି ପେଟରେ ଆସନ୍ତୁ।
sentences.roman: rôktô ṭesṭ paiṃ khali peṭôre asôntu.
sentences.en: Please come on an empty stomach for the blood test.
When will I get the test report?
I'm scared of injections.
Grandpa has been admitted to hospital.

sentences.native: ସେ କେତେ ଦିନ ହେଲା ଭର୍ତ୍ତି ଅଛନ୍ତି?
sentences.roman: se kete dinô hela bhôrtti ôchhônti?
sentences.en: How long has he been in hospital?
Is the doctor seeing patients today? (lit. will the doctor sit)
The doctor won't see you without an appointment.
Blood tests are done from eight in the morning.
Eat light food for a few days.

sentences.native: ଜ୍ୱର ସମୟରେ ତେଲ ମସଲା ଖାଇବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
sentences.roman: jwôrô sômôyôre telô môsôla khaiba uchitô nuheṃ.
sentences.en: You shouldn't eat oily, spicy food when you have a fever.

sentences.native: ଥଣ୍ଡା ପାଣି ପିଅ ନାହିଁ, ସର୍ଦ୍ଦି ହେବ।
sentences.roman: thôṇḍa paṇi piô nahiṃ, sôrddi hebô.
sentences.en: Don't drink cold water, you'll catch a cold.

sentences.native: ଏବେ କେମିତି ଲାଗୁଛି? ଜ୍ୱର ଅଛି କି?
sentences.roman: ebe kemiti laguchhi? jwôrô ôchhi ki?
sentences.en: How are you feeling now? Still got a fever?

sentences.native: ଆଜି ଟିକେ ଭଲ ଲାଗୁଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଲାଗୁଛି।
sentences.roman: aji ṭike bhôlô laguchhi, kintu durbôḷô laguchhi.
sentences.en: I feel a bit better today, but weak.
I'm completely better now.

sentences.native: ଶୀଘ୍ର ସୁସ୍ଥ ହୁଅ, ମୁଁ କାଲି ଦେଖା କରିବାକୁ ଆସିବି।
sentences.roman: sighrô susthô huô, muṃ kali dekha kôribaku asibi.
sentences.en: Get well soon — I'll come and see you tomorrow.
Stop eating outside food.

sentences.native: ଡାକ୍ତର କହିଲେ ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତାହ ଯାଏ ତେଲ ମସଲା ବନ୍ଦ।
sentences.roman: ḍaktôrô kôhile dui sôptahô jae telô môsôla bôndô.
sentences.en: The doctor said no oily or spicy food for two weeks.
